# opnsense_nginx_stream_server (Resource)

nginx stream servers (**Services ▸ Nginx ▸ Configuration ▸ Streams ▸ Stream Server**, plugin `os-nginx`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_log_format` (String) Access Log Format. One of `main`, `main_ext`, `anonymized`, `disabled`. Defaults to `main`.
- `ca` (String) CA Certificate. Defaults to ``.
- `certificate` (String) TLS Certificate. Defaults to ``.
- `error_log_level` (String) Select Error Log Level. Log levels are listed in the order of increasing verbosity. Setting a certain log level will cause all messages of the specified and more severe log levels to be logged. One of `emerg`, `alert`, `crit`, `error`, `warn`, `notice`, `info`. Defaults to `info`.
- `ip_acl` (String) If you select an IP ACL, the client can only access this service if it fulfills this requirement. Defaults to ``.
- `listen_address` (Set of String) Enter a list of IP addresses and ports which can be used in nginx listen directives. To listen on a port on all IPs, use for example "22,[::]:22". Defaults to `[]`.
- `proxy_connect_timeout` (Number) Defines a timeout (in seconds) for establishing a connection with a proxied server. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `proxy_protocol` (Boolean) If you enable the proxy protocol, a downstream proxy can send the client IP and port before the real traffic is set. Defaults to `false`.
- `proxy_responses` (Number) Due to the nature of UDP, nginx cannot know, when the communication ends and this helps as it tells nginx the number of datagrams the communication is expected to last on server side and it is expected to be closed afterwards. If you enter 0, it is expected, that the server never responds to a datagram. If nginx gets a datagram, it will still get forwarded to the client. Setting this option might be useful in (mostly) unidirectional communication as well. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `proxy_timeout` (Number) Sets the timeout (in seconds) between two successive read or write operations on client or proxied server connections. Defaults to `-1` (OPNsense default).
- `route_field` (String) Route With. One of `upstream`, `sni_upstream_map`. Defaults to `upstream`.
- `sni_upstream_map` (String) Select an upstream map to choose the host based on the name given by the client. Defaults to ``.
- `syslog_targets` (Set of String) SYSLOG targets. Defaults to `[]`.
- `trusted_proxies` (Set of String) Enter a list of IP addresses or CIDR networks which are allowed to override the source IP address using the specified header. Defaults to `[]`.
- `udp` (Boolean) UDP Port. Defaults to `false`.
- `upstream` (String) Select an upstream to proxy to. Defaults to ``.
- `verify_client` (String) On: the certificate is requested and validated. Use this option to protect a service with TLS authentication.Off: The certificate is not requested. Choose this option for a normal website.Optional: The certificate is requested and validated if existing. Choose this option for websites, with TLS login support or mixed TLS protected API and web content.Optional, don't verify: Do accept the certificate and let the application choose what to do. Choose this option, for the same reasons as optional but in this case, the request is passed to the backend without rejecting untrusted certificates. One of `off`, `on`, `optional`, `optional_no_ca`. Defaults to `off`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the nginx stream server.
